The Montran Enhanced Filtering System (EFS) provides comprehensive payments filtering and sanctions screening capabilities. It supports all common message formats including ISO 20022 (pacs, pain, camt), SWIFT MT, ISO 8583, NACHA, and local CSM formats. The system integrates via REST APIs, SOAP, IBM MQ, Apache Kafka, and file-based protocols. It supports compliance lists from around the world including OFAC, European OFAC, Lloyds MIU, and OFSI. Designed for both commercial banks seeking individual solutions and central institutions looking for a centralized multi-tenant SaaS offering to participant banks. Optimized for instant payments with native ISO 20022 support.
